content.text: Lots of kids Milo's age still co-sleep, and it's very fixable at five. Start with the room, not the bed. Tonight, do a short, calm bedtime routine in his own bed, tell him the plan ("I'll sit with you until you're sleepy, then I'll be right down the hall"), and stay on a chair beside him until he drifts off. Once that feels easy, move the chair a bit farther away every few nights. Let him help pick a nightlight or a stuffed buddy so it feels like his project.
